featured.title: Students in Gaza ‘devastated’ after plan for them to study in Belgium fails
featured.summary: Belgian government unable to agree on evacuation of 13 students to take up scholarships at universities Students who are unable to leave Gaza and take up scholarships at Belgian universities have said they are devastated after Belgium’s government hit deadlock on a plan enabling them to leave the war-torn territory. Ahmed Abujami, a 28-year-old doctor in Gaza, said he was “deeply disappointed” after Belgium’s five-party coalition government last Friday failed to agree on an evacuation plan for 13 students and researchers in the territory. Abujami has a scholarship to do a one-year master’s degree in public health at the Institute of Tropical Medicine in Antwerp. He hopes to gain skills and experience to rebuild Gaza’s shattered health system. Continue reading...

featured.titleZh: 加沙学生因赴比利时留学计划落空而感到“崩溃”

featured.summaryZh: 英国气候变化委员会表示，除非航空业承担碳清除成本，否则政府不应批准希思罗机场的扩建计划。委员会警告称，扩建项目将导致英国无法实现2050年净零排放目标。

In a letter sent to Susie Wiles, the White House chief of staff, on Monday, Garcia expressed concern about “any possible foreign entanglement” between the president’s son and the oligarch, Umar Kremlev. usa.title: US House votes for third time to end Iran war after $38bn cost is revealed
usa.summary: Damaging budget report estimates cost will grow by $3bn per month and stockpiles of weapons could take five years to rebuild The US House of Representatives has voted for a third time to end the war in Iran, approving a war powers resolution a few hours after a Congressional Budget Office (CBO) report showed the conflict had cost at least $38bn and left America’s stockpile of defensive missiles so depleted it could take five years to rebuild. The final tally of 220-204 was similar to earlier votes, with a few more Republicans joining most Democrats in calling for an end to the war. None of the resolutions have made it to the president’s desk, where Trump would almost certainly veto them. Continue reading...

items.title: Students in Gaza ‘devastated’ after plan for them to study in Belgium fails

Abujami has a scholarship to do a one-year master’s degree in public health at the Institute of Tropical Medicine in Antwerp. items.summaryZh: 北京香山论坛作为中国最重要的年度防务会议正在举行，吸引了全球约200名防务官员和专家参与。该论坛被视为中国对标新加坡香格里拉对话的重要国际安全交流平台。
items.whyImportant: 香山论坛的举办展示了中国在国际安全议题上日益增强的议程设置能力和影响力。

items.title: Chinese scientists build world’s smallest CT scanner, weighing just 6kg
items.summary: Chinese researchers have developed the world’s smallest CT scanner, a portable device designed to produce images of tiny fossils and archaeological relics. Built by the Shandong province-based Rayim, the Xtomo-Cube is about the size of a desktop speaker and weighs just 6kg (13.2lbs). “The device can be held in one hand and is the world’s smallest and lightest CT system, earning it the nickname ‘palm-sized CT scanner’,” Liu Baodong, a senior engineer at the Chinese Academy of Sciences and general...
items.titleZh: 中国科学家研制出全球最小CT扫描仪，重量仅6公斤
items.summaryZh: 中国研究人员开发出一种名为“Xtomo-Cube”的便携式CT扫描仪，重量仅为6公斤。该设备体积小巧，主要用于对小型化石和考古文物进行成像分析。
items.whyImportant: 这一技术突破展示了中国在精密医疗成像设备小型化领域的创新能力。

items.title: Sanders and Bannon call for AI limits, as public unease grows
items.summary: Progressive US Senator Bernie Sanders and ⁠Steve Bannon, a close ally of US President Donald Trump, called on Tuesday for restrictions on AI systems, uniting two political adversaries around concerns that the technology will harm humans. The two appeared at the same Washington gathering and warned of the potentially catastrophic consequences AI poses to humanity, as concern about its risks spreads beyond Washington and Silicon Valley. Speaking first, Sanders, a self-described democratic...
items.titleZh: 桑德斯与班农呼吁限制人工智能，公众不安情绪加剧
items.summaryZh: 美国参议员桑德斯与特朗普盟友班农罕见达成共识，共同呼吁对人工智能系统实施限制。两人在华盛顿的活动中警告称，人工智能可能对人类构成灾难性风险。
items.whyImportant: 跨党派政治人物对AI风险的共同担忧，反映了人工智能监管已成为美国社会各界关注的焦点。

items.title: Top Democrat on House oversight panel investigating Trump Jr wedding party bankrolled by Russian oligarch
items.summary: Robert Garcia expresses concern over ‘any possible foreign entanglement’ between White House and Umar Kremlev Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on the House oversight committee, is investigating potential ties between the White House and a Russian oligarch who paid for a portion of Donald Trump Jr’s wedding. In a letter sent to Susie Wiles, the White House chief of staff, on Monday, Garcia expressed concern about “any possible foreign entanglement” between the president’s son and the oligarch, Umar Kremlev. Garcia asked Wiles to provide documents, records and communications between the White House and Trump Jr about Kremlev, among other requests. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 众议院监督委员会民主党领袖调查小特朗普婚礼资金来源，涉及俄罗斯寡头
items.summaryZh: 众议院监督委员会首席民主党人罗伯特·加西亚正在调查白宫与俄罗斯寡头乌马尔·克雷姆列夫之间可能存在的联系。克雷姆列夫曾为小唐纳德·特朗普的婚礼提供部分资金，加西亚已要求白宫提供相关通信记录以评估是否存在外国干预风险。
items.whyImportant: 此调查旨在审查白宫与外国势力之间是否存在潜在的利益冲突或不当关联。

items.title: Ed Sheeran tour in trouble as support acts quit over pro-Palestinian speech fallout
items.summary: Ed Sheeran’s tour of North and South America was plunged into chaos Tuesday when four of his supporting acts abruptly quit in solidarity with the rapper Macklemore, who was dropped for making pro-Palestinian comments on stage. Hours after Sheeran posted on social media about Macklemore’s ousting and attributed the decision to the tour’s promoters, Irish acts Aaron Rowe and Beoga, the Danish band Lukas Graham, and Finneas posted on social media that they were leaving the tour. Rowe and Lukas...
items.titleZh: 艾德·希兰巡演陷入困境，多位助演嘉宾因亲巴勒斯坦言论争议退出
items.summaryZh: 因说唱歌手麦克勒莫发表亲巴勒斯坦言论被取消演出资格，多位助演嘉宾为表示声援相继退出艾德·希兰的巡演。包括Aaron Rowe、Beoga、Lukas Graham和Finneas在内的多组艺人宣布退出，导致巡演陷入混乱。
items.whyImportant: 艺人的政治立场引发的连锁反应对大型商业巡演的运营造成了直接冲击。

items.title: US House votes for third time to end Iran war after $38bn cost is revealed
items.summary: Damaging budget report estimates cost will grow by $3bn per month and stockpiles of weapons could take five years to rebuild The US House of Representatives has voted for a third time to end the war in Iran, approving a war powers resolution a few hours after a Congressional Budget Office (CBO) report showed the conflict had cost at least $38bn and left America’s stockpile of defensive missiles so depleted it could take five years to rebuild. The final tally of 220-204 was similar to earlier votes, with a few more Republicans joining most Democrats in calling for an end to the war. None of the resolutions have made it to the president’s desk, where Trump would almost certainly veto them. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 美国众议院第三次投票要求结束伊朗战争，战争成本已达380亿美元
items.summaryZh: 美国众议院以220票对204票再次通过决议，要求结束伊朗战争。国会预算办公室报告显示，该战争已耗资380亿美元，且防御导弹库存严重不足，补充库存可能需要五年时间。
items.whyImportant: 该投票反映了国会对战争成本及国防储备消耗的担忧，尽管总统可能会行使否决权。

items.title: First Lady Melania Trump’s Special Visit to Ashe County, North Carolina Bearing Witness to a Community’s Resilience
items.summary: First Lady Melania Trump returned to North Carolina to visit Mountain View Elementary School in Ashe County, nearly two years after her initial visit to a community devastated by Hurricane Helene. “True resilience means having the courage to look ahead and move society forward, creating a better future,” the First Lady said. This visit shared […] The post First Lady Melania Trump’s Special Visit to Ashe County, North Carolina Bearing Witness to a Community’s Resilience appeared first on The White House.
items.titleZh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普访问北卡罗来纳州阿什县，见证社区韧性
items.summaryZh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普重返北卡罗来纳州阿什县，访问了飓风“海伦”灾后重建中的山景小学。她强调了社区在面对灾难时展现出的勇气与向前看的韧性。
items.whyImportant: 此次访问旨在展示政府对灾后重建社区的持续关注与支持。

items.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
items.summary: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".
items.titleZh: 五角大楼监察长证实：伊朗战争导致美国弹药短缺
items.summaryZh: 五角大楼监察长的一份报告证实，尽管特朗普总统声称美国供应“几乎无限”，但伊朗战争已导致美国弹药储备不足。报告同时指出补给链存在严重瓶颈。
items.whyImportant: 该结论揭示了战争对美国国防工业能力的实际压力，与官方表态存在矛盾。
